title: Video storyboard coverage plan

id.description: Stable unique storyboard identifier. Defaults to the target HTML ID.

selector.description: Optional single HTML ID selector. Defaults to #id.

start.description: Expected start in absolute output seconds.

end.description: Expected end in output seconds; the runtime requires end > start.

description: Runtime validation also requires unique element IDs and strictly increasing start/end intervals. Static coverage does not prove rendered visibility.
